thread:
sara: Quick pre-shift note — saw an autoscaler surge in ap-south-1 around 04:12 UTC, launching an extra 6 nodes. Not sure if it's misconfigured cooldown or a loop. Raising so night shift sees it. /cc @liam

liam: Got the alert. Looking at INF-3421 (https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-3421). Alert shows scale events every ~30s. :eyes:

ops-bot: Alert: AUTOSCALER_SCALE_UP spike in cluster ap-south-1 at 2024-11-09T04:12:20Z — 6 nodes launched. Metric: pending_pods > 50 for 300s.

cheng: I pulled logs — looks like a race in the prewarm job where pod readiness probe fails then restarts trigger pending pods. snippet:
```
prewarm-worker: readiness probe failed: timeout
kubelet: pod restart count: 4
autoscaler: scale_up request for 6 nodes
```

maya: Quick mitigation: I've lowered the prewarm replicas from 4->1 in ap-south stack and added a 60s stabilization window to the HPA. Run:
```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa prewarm-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'
```

maya: This should stop the constant pending pods while we debug readiness flakiness. I'll open a PR to change readiness probe timeout to 60s. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1297

liam: Thanks. I'll own INF-3421 and follow up with a hotfix for autoscaler stabilization in case probe fixes take time. Assigning to @liam. ETA 2h for hotfix verification.

sara: Thanks team. I'll note in the handoff: EU->US oncall, watch ap-south-1 scale events, do not manually scale unless T-shirt owner confirms. If anything else shows up ping me.

liam: Will do. Also requesting @cheng for quick CR on the probe timeout PR — tests look green locally but want second pair of eyes. :thumbsup:

cheng: On it, reviewing now. If ok we can merge and rollout to ap-south patch channel.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-3421 by liam: 'ap-south autoscaler loop mitigated by reducing prewarm replicas and HPA stabilization. Follow-up: readiness probe fix in infra repo.'
